verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents reminders for personnel to complete assigned tasks, including security awareness training completion. That implies training is assigned and tracked within the product. Beyond that single mention, the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: evidence that training content is built in (rather than delivered by a third-party LMS), automatic assignment on hire, completion tracking dashboards or records, explicit acceptance of training records as audit evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
